payment_and_dispatch_boundaries: Fixed-price buyer funds can be deposited before work begins on Upwork.
Individual freelancer subcontracting requires client consent; silent subcontracting is forbidden.
Agency structure is a transparent multi-person contract path but does not by itself prove demand or margin.
Public domestic crowd payout bands are reference signals, not executable quotes.
Travel, QA and rework must be bounded before raw spread can become normalized contribution margin.
UU MCP proves quote/order/track for errand/delivery primitives only; evidence-capture acceptance remains unproven.
